title: Vibe Coding OS Template
description: Contract for reusable markdown templates under templates/.

filename.description: Relative path or filename of the template inside the templates directory.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what the template produces.

title.description: First markdown heading in the template, e.g. # Spec: <title>.

sections.description: Ordered list of required section headings present in the template body.

fillable_placeholders.description: Representative placeholder tokens or placeholder list from the template.

related_skills.description: Optional skill or command paths related to this template.
